system.description: Sistema AVRA de elementos de la envolvente del edificio.

generation_provenance.retrieval_policy: Do not invent source-dependent numeric values; preserve inaccessible current IVE values as null with explicit status.

IVE-BDC.note: Terminal BDC26 URLs are reachable, but selected price, BC3 decomposition and GWP values are dynamically rendered and were not exposed to the web crawler.

CTE-CEC.note: Used for roof slot semantics and reference U-value equations.

CYPE.note: CYPE prices are stored only as secondary observations when configuration/scope differs from the IVE primary solution.

generation_provenance.gwp_policy: IVE BDC displays A1-A2-A3 GWP-tot, but no selected-solution GWP was transferred unless directly retrievable.
generation_provenance.cost_scope_note: IVE roof items are treated as build-up above the structural support; the generic 200 mm RC slab is not included in canonical IVE cost/GWP.

poc_synthetic_completion.policy_override: At the user request, unresolved/null values were completed with coherent synthetic estimates. Original source-dependent claims remain distinguishable through statuses and data_quality_notes.
poc_synthetic_completion.ifc_note: Referenced IFC files in this demo bundle are minimal synthetic IFC4 placeholders, not design BIM models.
